title: Canonical SDF decoder with per-shape Mirror coordinates
hypothesis: A shared canonical function with small shape-view coordinates reproduces held-out function instances with lower actual storage than independent per-shape payloads; Mirror-specific value must beat native direct conditioning.
storage: Measure actual compressed inference .npz bytes, including decoder definition/state, codes, indices and schema; deterministic analytic decoder may be represented by fixed versioned code metadata only if reconstruction is exact and included in schema accounting.
compute: Count pointwise arithmetic operations and report wall time; no fitting optimizer updates.
success_gate: Both development seeds: held-out audit nRMSE <=1e-5 and shared-view payload <=25% independent grids. Mirror-specific success additionally requires improving bytes or compute over native direct conditioning at matched quality.
failure_gate: Quality/storage gate miss or native direct conditioning is an exact equal-cost alias. Fresh stays sealed on any failure.
boundaries: No learned decoder training or general 3D shape claim
No quality measured on real scans
No protocol changes after development starts
